title: Is an infeasible MAIC calibration signaled, and by what?
question: MAIC has no solution when the target mean lies outside the convex hull of the source covariates. How often does that happen, does the optimizer say so, and can ESS, the maximum weight or the residual balance tell infeasible analyses from hard feasible ones?
design: Binary-outcome MAIC with 3 or 8 covariates, target shifts set to give 0 to 90% infeasibility by linear program, with and without effect modification; 24 cells. 1000 replicates per cell.
